QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_33

question.text: Consolidated IRR reported to SEBI aggregates cash flows across:

answer.text: All schemes of all AIFs in India
All Category III AIFs managed by the SAME Investment Manager

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 6.2.1, Consolidated IRR sums cash inflows/outflows of all Cat III AIFs managed by the same IM. **The Trap:** Not all India-wide; not only successful/LVF. **Cross-Exam Context:** Important for manager-level performance comparison. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** When comparing IMs, ask for consolidated IRR to see their aggregate track record.
